[quote=norrhollow;58507924][b]Austmark is Albic![/b]

The Office for the High Albic Ministry of Foreign Affairs would criticize the "alarmist" language employed by Thýven against the people of High Albany. 

In a statement on the early hours of 16 February 2025, Minister Alice J. Ostman would characterize the actions of the State Defense Acting Quorum as being a [i]"...detriment to the peace and tranquility of the White Sea"[/i], further stating that [i]"... any accusations of Austmark as a forward operating base are born out of a disservice to the good will of the Albic people"[/i], explaining that the occupation and eventual integration of Austmark had been done by the State of Norrhollow with democratic support in order to foster development for its declining fishery sectors due to rapid market globalization.

In response to Thrømm attempts to expand its naval presence in the region, Minister Ostman would pledge to also increase High Albic naval power in the White Sea until "in good time, the Thrømm government acknowledge the rights of High Albany to the island of Austmark, a geological body that exists outside the boundaries of the Thrømm area of responsibility and which has always been considered a cultural artifact of the state of Norrhollow and of all High Albany.

Shortly before departing, Minister Ostman would also lament upon what she sees as a [i]... "visceral decline in Norric-Thrømm relations"[/i], lamenting Thýven ease at accusing its own brothers and sisters of the same blood across the White Sea, while at the same time adopting a conciliatory and even enthusiastic rapport with Shamantine states looking to do business from far across the North Sea.

On the sudden militarization of Hydronia, Ostman would decline to comment, stating that [i]"... what happens in East Shamat does not require the consent or commentary of High Albany."[/i], though she would stress for calm and dialogue.[/quote]
[b]Free Austmark!  Eh not really.[/b]
The foreign minister of Thýven, Frederik Theodor Christoffer Mikkelsen-Lauritzen, a middling buck, was not one to be grieved into reversing decisions made on behalf of the ministry by the Gøsfodd. As a result of the tiff he had been ordered to find any and all information related to Austmark and its inhabitants, pre-albany. Unfortunately for any imperialists or even nationalists in Thýven there seemed to be little record of any contact with the island in question with the modern state of Thýven, although some contact had been made by the older island kingdoms of Knygta and Deyn (Now duchies), these holds had not been maintained.

The information in question was soon presented to Queen Mij Drs, who for all intents and purposes was like the Queen Elizabeth II of Thýven, a beloved yet controversial monarch, credited with restoring the constitution, but also increasing royal oversight in the legislature. Using this information given to her by the foreign department, along with information by the National Intelligence Directorate. She would call for a peaceful solution to the question of the Island. The statement still held notes of tension within its wording, it didn't mention who owned the Island or who should own the island, nor did it recognise any claim to the island, it was blunt and slightly forceful, but not in a way to suggest violence.

[quote=-chimor;58504695][b]Wápìwan, the god of death, and the fall of Kon[/b]
[i]The humanity were thriving, the most successful of all gods creations, the third age creatures were created by clay, and the gods conceded them the gift of a soul, the creatures would be free to decide whatever they want, without gods intervention, unless demanded.
There was among the humans however, the false sensation of eternity, just like the gods, but we can not blame them, after all, not a single human died at  the time.
Where the Mayao encounters the inner sea, there was a city named Máchamò,  ruled by a elderly man, called Béchup Pañan, he was very ill and sick, on his death bed, no one could do anything, no human would be capable of helping the man, at least not without divine miracle, but what came was not divine, neither a miracle.
It emerged from the skies, it had a body of condor, but feathers dark as void, and it eyes carried something uncomfortable, making even the most sane person become insane by just looking at it, that was Wápìwan, the death, something the humans did not even know, those who tried to save the poor old man, were driven insane by the thing glancing their eyes into them, those who tried intervene, were driven insane, and the thing gone to the man, it talons pierced it flesh, taking a grey and translucid version of the man's body, and the death fly away Béchup never wake up again.
[b]Just like where is dark, there is light, Where is life, there must have death, i am not here to kill, but to bring stability[/b].
The creature proclaimed soon before fly away, but, Kon feel the darkness on his boneless body, it was the feeling of one of his creations dying, a feeling he did not had since he imprisioned his brother in the sea, could it be Samanteman again?, no...that should be impossible, as soon he moved with his agile and fast body to the creature, he shown disgust by it.
"You will not kill my creations "
He roared to the thing, his winds throwing trees at the thing, but it was...useless.
"You are not a god, you are not a creation of me or my brother, what are yo-"
"I am not a creation, neither a god, i am the what this world does not want, but needs, i am the [b]inevitable[/b]"
The divine winds did nothing to the creature, the trees were erased, soon the thing moved fast, in a single thrust with it claws, Kon had his body pierced,  his blood fallen making the last rivers of Erene, he was in pain, not for his wounds, but due his defeat, his fall from a supreme god, now being defeated, his last deed was look into Wápìwan eyes, he seen his fall , the death of every single human, every single creation killed by Samanteman, every single death in a second, that looked a eternity, he fallen from the skies, which darkened, Chilla and Chatay cried, making silver, gold and corn creation, now Kon no longer raisen to the Chomuñapû top, humilliated, he now wander around the mountains, while Chatay and Chilla emerged as new supreme gods.
[b]The fate of the dead.[/b]
Those who die, are accompanied by Wápìwan, who observes them on the corner of their vision, after their death, their spirit is taken away by it, it flies to Sùpâchó, with the souls imprisioned, where those who commited evil, are comndened to wander around the forest eternally seeking the Pâkatwan river, which they will never find, Sùpay, the "devil", usually diverts himself by torturing the impure souls, or making them one of his servents, those who did good, or at least remained as pure as possible and did not commit any bad deeds, are guided by Táncûy, the ferryman that guides the dead over the Pâkatwan in a wooden boat, each soul has a history to tell him, as a price to travel, a history of their lives, as much they want, after every soul finish their histories, Táncûy arrives the destination, the Wápítî, there is no torment, or any torture to those who arrive there, just peace, where at center, the Condor observes everything in his domains(Wápítî), and observe the living.

[/i]
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP[/quote]
[b]Sùpay(devil, deity of evil and darkness) [/b]
Note: many versions of the origin and appearance of Sùpay , will not comment about each one, but a few.
Rúchìr Rakála version.
The one who written most of what he heard about the mythology, from the origin of the world, to each god description, origin and family, to heroes rising and  history , any part of mythology without any other writer name above, us from Rakála.

[i]Born between the 1st 2nd Age, first kid of Kon and Camác, a humanoid being, with claws of cougar on his fingers, and head of cougar , brother of Chilla and Chatay , god of metals and the soil, 
However, when Samanteman once again destroyed his brother's creation, contrary to what Kon was expecting, Sùpay turned against his father, and when the war clashed, Sùpay alongside Samantemán, fought against Kon , Camác and their kids.
¿The reason?
Simple, Chilla and Chatay obfuscated Sùpay, while Chilla was adored for the births, and moon cycles, while Chatay was adored by the simple fact of being the daylight, who keeps the world warm from freezing, while Supay ruled the metals and soil , being more related to the war and military,  he was feared among mortals, and Samantemán convinced him to fight alongside him.
"you are the eldest , but the most obfuscated, join me , and i will make you great, and reign in a world without the tyranny of Kon, you will not be feared, but adored just like your siblings"
Chatay and Chilla fought against their rebellious brother.
While Kon and Camác fought, Chilla and Chatay fought their brother, while Sùpay on a powerful metallic armour, fought his brother's rays of light defending by making a iron shield to protect himself, while Rúchìr version did not mention what Chatay's blood became after being hit by Supay's metallic claws, other authors say his blood became the gold.
Seeing his brother losing, Chilla descended from mountains in her [b]Chískô[/b](a night bird with grey-silver feathers).
The moment she landed, she took a more... humanoid form, a woman in a white and blue dress, with a silver mantle.
"brother, you do not see how you are being used?
You are the son of Erene/Camác and the winds/Kón, ¡not the son of darkness !"
Chilla said, she did not attacked, was reluctant to fight, and tried to convince Sùpay to not fight.
"I was forced to live in the darkness , while you controlled the cycles of moon and fertility, Chatay was adored for his rays of light and warm were all adored and celebrated, Samantemán promised me what our father refused to me, the right to rule, the right to be adored and celebrated, not feared".
Sùpay said in response to Chilla, Chatay, despite wounded, said to his sister.
"We have to choice, Chilla, ¡all we have to do is attack!"
Chatay then advanced with another attack, a blast of light, which Sùpay defended invoking a metallic wall, which melt due the attack, but Sùpay remained untouched, and with the melted metal, made several blades and attacked Chilla and Chatay, while Chatay protected himself with a shield of light, melting the blades, Chilla was hit, and wounded, she bleed, a liquid metal surged, mercury surged.
[b] ENOUGH [/b]
She screamed, and with her hands, Chilla altered the time itself, by with her hands controlling the Moon Cycles(in a limited range, but still powerful), she made to the New phase, which she was healed, alongside Chatay, while Sùpay had his armour rust and be destroyed, while the blades piercing Chilla evaporated,  then moved to the Full Moon phase , now, Chilla and Chatay did a single ray of light, the white light of the moon alongside the sunlight , destroyed Sùpay's armour, before he could counter, their mother Camác Intervened, and imprisoned Sùpay with her roots emerging from the soil.
After Samantemán being imprisoned in the sea, Kón had remorse for his son, instead of imprisoning him, he and Chilla removed his powers controlling the metals and soil.
After wandering for many time, Sùpay became ruler of the darkness, after some time, he begin to rule Sùpâchó, his devil presence corrupts the forest, and it lifeforms, his domains are where evil people who die are sent to Sùpâchó, where Sùpay make, sometimes his servants, or even minor deities, he can control everything and everyone under his domains in Sùpâchó.
[/i]

[b]The ferryman of the dead, Táncuy [/b].
[i]As old as the concept of death itself, while Wápìwan capture those who die of age, and bring them to Táncuy, who leads them to the Wápítî.[/i]
[i]Wacháy made Camác, Kón, Samantemán, Apû-Sáman (lord of mountains) and Táncuy, when the first deities surged, Táncuy also was created, making him a primordial, as old as time itself, when the first beings were extinct by Samantemán, Táncuy guided them through the Pâkatwan, where he was designed to rule.
Each soul had to tell him a history, he already has knowledge of everything that enters his boat, but demands a history to travel, at the time where Wápítî was not a thing, those who end their histories, were sent to islands created by Táncuy himself, reflecting their histories and personality.
No one can lie to Táncuy, if they do, he will recreate the person's life on the river's waters.
When Wápìwan surged, Wápìwan asked Wápìwan permission for him to give the river's souls to Wápìwan, and Táncuy to guide souls to the Wápítî , and he accepted.

Appearance: Táncuy appearance depends on who is seeing, he has no real form as it depends on the viewer, but always has a dark mantle.
[/i]
[i]
Sùpay once tried to enter the Wápìwan, and take the dead for himself and destroy the Wápítî, he had to face Táncuy to do such.
He had dark obsidian horns, and a cougar face with many scars on it.
"Begone from my sight, Ferryman."
He said in a several tone, anyone that close to Sùpay would run in fear, due his fear aura  and darkness, the trees begin to die, and the grass gone darker and darker due his presence , but Táncuy did not moved a inch, and remained calm, almost bored.
"your darkness and fear is as useless as the lies told by every soul, the river will not bow to your darkness, fallen god."
Sùpay retreated, surprised to the words "fallen god", he yelled angry, and said.
[b]YOU WAS NOT THERE WHEN I LOST MY GLORY[/b]
The vegetation around got even darker, while the clouds and skies became darker with lightings forming 
Táncuy laugh.
"I am here since the first dead, you are not the first, neither the last one to challenge me to enter the Wápítî."
Sùpay roared,  the very own river moved, but Táncuy did keep without moving, from the shadows, he made blades darker than void, and launched toward the ferryman, but it was useless, the blades past throught him.
"you are attacking nothing but yourself fallen god"
Táncuy said ironical to Sùpay, then with a gesture with hands he made a wave that hit Sùpay, not a attack, but a illusion.
"brother, you do not see how you are being used?"
"¡you are being used brother!
The illusions of his past, are coming to him.
[b] ENOUGH [/b]
He then seem, not just seem, but had the exact same feeling when his siblings attacked him together, destroying his armour and feeling the cold and heat at same time...
"NO NO, THAT IS NOT REAL"
he tried to attack the water, then Táncuy voice emerged.
"you can not defeat the truth, Sùpay"
Then feel the roots of Camác roots emerging from soil imprisoning him, he heard his mom saying.
"you could be loved, but fallen in tentation of your uncle".
"NO NO, I WILL NOT FALL HERE"
Sùpay invoked a vortex of darkness and tried take over the river and Táncuy, who for the first time, gave a bother and looked at Sùpay.
"Thou shall not pollute my river with your darkness, you are not worth of this river "
He made a gesture towards the fallen god and the waves moved violently towards him, and engulfed Sùpay.
"this river is older than your darkness , you fallen once, and will fall once again."
After that, he made a gesture, which made the river drag the darkness God into the river, chained by the water, unbreakable , he still tried summon the darkness to save him, but failed, the water destroyed his feeble tries to leave the river domains.
After some time, Táncuy made a column of water and launched the fallen god to the skies and was launched back to Sùpâchó.
"Yet another one that challenged the Pâkatwan, but failed, not the first, not the last".
Táncuy said after launching Sùpay and going back to take new souls to travel.

[/i]
